sloka: स भग्नबाहूरुभुजो विह्वलः शोणितोक्षितः ।मुमोह सहसा वीरो मुहूर्तं कपिकुञ्जरः ।। ५.६२.२८ ।।।।
transliteration: sa bhagnabāhūrubhujo vihvalaḥ śoṇitokṣitaḥ ।mumoha sahasā vīro muhūrtaṁ kapikuñjaraḥ ।। 5.62.28 ।।।।

translations.english: The heroic Dadhimukha, an elephant among monkeys, with his shoulders and arms broken, and body drenched in blood lost his consciousness instantly.
